skill.displayName: Top Brand Core Builder(顶级品牌内核构建)
skill.summary: 帮助用户构建具有强穿透力的极致品牌内核；当用户需要创建新品牌、升级现有品牌或设计品牌战略时使用

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of top-brand-core-builder

- Provides a comprehensive framework for constructing highly penetrating brand cores, suitable for creating new brands, upgrading existing brands, or designing brand strategies
- Introduces concepts like energy penetration chain, high-density core expression, six-force model, and dependency structures for building brand indispensability
- Offers actionable step-by-step methods and illustrative use cases for individuals, startups, and multi-brand groups
- Includes a suite of diagnostic and analysis scripts for core assessment, penetration consistency, competitor comparison, and core generation
- Provides extensive resources, guides, case studies, and templates for practical brand building and evaluation
